steps.title: Complete The Gauntlet until you receive …
steps.text: Complete The Gauntlet until you receive an Enhanced crystal weapon seed and 6 Crystal armour seeds. — If you happen to get 2 Enhanced seeds, keep the second one! You can use it as a blade of saeldor. — If you don't get the lucky second enhanced, read the notable alternatives section about continuing on for a blade.

steps.title: Make the Bow of faerdhinen, and …
steps.text: Make the Bow of faerdhinen, and crystal armour.
